ai.rationale: Most contemporary AI bet in the field — voice-first interface to a live NBA game via Gemini Live native audio is genuinely novel, since most sports apps are visual-first and conversational live-game Q&A pushes the edge of what current models can do. Companion StatsCast layer (streaming analyst breakdowns + animated season stats) shows ambition without losing focus. All three URLs filled (YouTube + repo + stable Vercel deploy). Held just under the top because the meta sells the experience but hand-waves the hardest part — how live-game data integration is actually grounded — and pairing two products in one submission slightly diffuses the pitch.
